column1: Melt the butter in a small saucepan, then stir in the maple syrup, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, ginger and pepper. Simmer 1–2 minutes.
Place the halibut in a baking dish and spoon half the glaze over it.
Bake about 15–20 minutes (estimate), basting once or twice with the remaining glaze, until the fish flakes easily and reaches 145°F (63°C).
Spoon the pan juices over the halibut and serve.
